Class PluggableFormulaEditorDialog

All Implemented Interfaces:

public class PluggableFormulaEditorDialog extends javafx.stage.Stage
Interactive Dialog invalid input: '&' Editor for Pluggable Statistics invalid input: '&' Formulas. Allows users to write custom mathematical/statistical formulas (SUM, AVG, MEDIAN, VAR, STDDEV, GINI), test them live against active simulation data, and import/export formula libraries.
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
